events.title: Trail Running 101 with Wild Earth & Trail Trips — Info Night
events.description: An informative session for those looking to get into trail running, covering gear, safety, and local trail recommendations. Perfect for connecting with fellow outdoor enthusiasts and building community.

events.title: Connecting Across Cultures: Exploring belonging, digital inclusion and community connection
events.description: A community-led event focused on fostering belonging and digital inclusivity through facilitated discussions and cultural exchange. Designed for those interested in social systems and community cohesion.

events.title: 6200+ Gold Coast International Meetup
events.location: The Cavill Hotel area, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A large-scale language exchange and social gathering designed to facilitate conversation between locals and international visitors in a relaxed environment. Excellent for meeting people from diverse cultural backgrounds.

events.title: Saturday Afternoon Board Games
events.description: A recurring, community-led board game session that encourages strategic thinking and social interaction. Suitable for those looking to meet thoughtful people over collaborative or competitive games.

events.title: Earth Valley Fire & Flow
events.description: A hands-on movement workshop focused on the art of fire-flow, combining physical coordination with creative expression in a beautiful setting. Great for beginners interested in performance art and movement.

events.title: Art in the Park - MQP Edition
events.location: One Arts Gold Coast, Isle of Capri
events.description: An open-air creative gathering featuring a picnic atmosphere and local maker stalls. An accessible, community-oriented space for meeting local artists and like-minded creatives.

events.title: Messy Queer Pride — Exhibition Open Day
events.location: One Arts Gold Coast, Isle of Capri
events.description: A grass-roots exhibition featuring multidisciplinary art and hands-on workshop opportunities. Focused on authentic expression and building a supportive creative community.

events.title: Is authenticity possible in an age of performance?
events.description: A philosophy discussion salon exploring the intersection of modern performance culture and the concept of the authentic self. Highly recommended for those who value intellectual debate and community discourse.
